condition: recombinant WT shell coexpressed with native EncFtn cargo in E. coli; EncFtn-loaded
notes: Canonical WT native-cargo-loaded T=1 assembly. Loaded-Enc formed regular nanocompartments approximately 21 nm in diameter. Cryo-EM directly resolved a T=1 icosahedral shell composed of 60 Enc subunits. Asymmetric reconstruction revealed four EncFtn decamers arranged tetrahedrally inside the shell, producing a symmetry mismatch with the icosahedral cage. PDB 7OE2 and 7OEU represent closed and open fivefold-pore pentamer conformations derived from symmetry expansion of this same Loaded-Enc assembly and are therefore handled in pore_records rather than as separate assemblies.
